# Kortex

> A personal knowledge base powered by the LLM Wiki protocol (Karpathy, 2024),
> with every page serialized as an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) concept
> document. Raw sources are synthesized once into an interlinked wiki that gets
> richer with each addition — queries hit the pre-synthesized layer, not the
> raw documents.

License: Apache-2.0
Language: English

## How to read it

Every HTML page is also served as clean Markdown. Send `Accept: text/markdown`
and a Cloudflare Worker strips the chrome and returns the page as Markdown,
close to its underlying OKF source, with an `x-markdown-tokens` hint header.

## Growth stages

Each entity page carries a growth badge derived from its OKF frontmatter:

- 🌱 Seedling — `status: draft` (just planted, unverified)
- 🌿 Budding — `status: stable`, `confidence` low or medium (partially verified)
- 🌳 Evergreen — `status: stable`, `confidence: high` (trusted, sources agree)
- 🍂 Archived — `status: deprecated` (retired)

A page past its `stale_after` instant also shows a "needs re-verify" marker.

## Entity types

- Domains — broad topic areas, the hub pages
- Concepts — ideas, frameworks and mental models
- Sources — books, papers and articles, synthesized
- Organizations — companies, foundations and standards bodies

## Structure

The site renders the `wiki/` OKF bundle directly. Builder-generated graph
nodes (`wiki/kb/`) and reserved files (`index.md`, `log.md`) are not published.

Source: https://github.com/nlamirault/kortex
